def.short: the place where two streets or two walls meet
def.long: The place where two streets, walls, or sides of something meet. In a town, shops and cafés are often on a street corner.

grammar.pattern: on / at the corner of + street

examples.en: The bakery is on the next corner.
Turn left at the corner, then walk to the end of the street.
examples.tr: Köşeden sola dönün, sonra sokağın sonuna kadar yürüyün.

examples.en: Sam put the new lamp in the corner of the living room.
examples.tr: Sam yeni lambayı oturma odasının köşesine koydu.

etymology.text: From Latin 'cornu' (horn, point) through Old French. A corner is a 'point' where two lines or walls meet.

tr.note: Futboldaki 'korner' kelimesi de buradan gelir: corner kick = köşe vuruşu. Sokak köşesi için 'on the corner', oda köşesi için 'in the corner' denir.

mistakes.wrong: The shop is in the corner of the street.
mistakes.right: The shop is on the corner of the street.
mistakes.why: Sokak köşesi dışarıdadır: 'on the corner'. 'In the corner' odanın veya kutunun iç köşesi için kullanılır.

tr.mnemonic: Futbolda 'korner' dersin ya: corner = köşe. Aynı kelime.

quiz.cloze: The café is on the ______ of Park Street and Main Street.

def.short: a structure that lets people or cars go across a river or road
def.long: A structure built over a river, a road, or a railway so that people and cars can go across it. Many big cities have a famous bridge.

examples.en: The bridge is closed because of the snow.
We walked across the bridge to the old town.
examples.tr: Köprüden yürüyerek karşıya geçip eski şehre gittik.

examples.en: Traffic on the bridge is very slow in the morning.
examples.tr: Köprüdeki trafik sabahları çok yavaş ilerliyor.

tr.note: Ünlü köprü adlarının başına çoğunlukla 'the' gelir: the Galata Bridge, the Bosphorus Bridge.

quiz.cloze: You can walk across the ______ to the other side of the river.

def.short: to go from one side of a street, river, or bridge to the other
def.long: To go from one side of something to the other, for example a street, a river, or a bridge. Always look both ways before you cross a busy road.

grammar.pattern: cross + the street / a road / a bridge

examples.en: Look left and right before you cross the street.
examples.tr: Karşıdan karşıya geçmeden önce sağa sola bak.

examples.en: The children crossed the bridge on their way to school.
We crossed the border into Bulgaria in the evening.

tr.note: Türkçede 'geçmek' hem 'cross' (karşıya geçmek) hem 'pass' (yanından geçmek) anlamına gelir. İngilizcede bunlar ayrıdır: cross = bir yandan öbür yana geçmek.

mistakes.wrong: Be careful when you pass the road.
mistakes.right: Be careful when you cross the road.
mistakes.why: Yolun karşısına geçmek 'cross'tur. 'Pass' yanından geçip gitmek içindir (pass the bank).

quiz.cloze: Please ______ the street at the traffic lights.

def.short: a road in a town or city with houses or shops along it
def.long: A public road in a town or city, with houses, shops, or offices on one or both sides. A 'road' often goes between places, but this word is usually inside a town.

examples.en: Our street is quiet at night.
She lives on Gül Street, near the park.
The street was full of people and music.

tr.note: Türkçede dar yol 'sokak', geniş yol 'cadde' olur; İngilizcede 'street' ikisini de karşılar. 'Road' ise daha çok iki yeri birbirine bağlayan yoldur.

quiz.cloze: Our house is on a quiet ______ near the park.

def.short: when the sky is covered and you cannot see much sun
def.long: Used when the sky is covered with grey or white clouds and you cannot see much sun. A day like this is often cooler than a sunny day.

examples.en: It is cloudy today, but it is not cold.
examples.tr: Bugün hava bulutlu ama soğuk değil.

examples.en: Tomorrow will be cloudy, with some rain in the evening.
examples.tr: Yarın hava bulutlu olacak, akşam biraz yağmur bekleniyor.

tr.note: Hava durumunda 'hava bulutlu / kapalı' denir. İngilizcede 'hava' kelimesini çevirmeyin: 'It is cloudy.' deyin.

mistakes.right: The weather is cloudy today. / It is cloudy today.
mistakes.why: 'Weather' önünde 'the' ister; en kolayı 'It is cloudy today.' demektir.

quiz.cloze: I can't see the sun. The sky is ______.

def.short: when the air outside moves fast and strongly
def.long: Used when the air outside moves fast and strongly. On a day like this, hats can fly away and the sea can be rough.

examples.en: It is very windy today, so take a jacket.
examples.tr: Bugün hava çok rüzgârlı, o yüzden mont al.

examples.en: Istanbul can be cold and windy in March.
examples.tr: İstanbul mart ayında soğuk ve rüzgârlı olabilir.

tr.note: 'Rüzgâr' isimdir (wind), 'rüzgârlı' sıfattır (windy). 'Breezy' daha hafif, tatlı bir rüzgâr demektir.

mistakes.why: İsim (wind) yerine sıfat gerekir: windy. Havadan söz ederken özne 'it' olur.

quiz.cloze: Hold your hat! It is very ______ today.

def.short: the season between summer and winter, when leaves fall
def.long: The season between summer and winter, from September to November in many countries. The weather gets cooler and the leaves fall from the trees.

examples.en: I love walking in the park in autumn.
Autumn is my favorite season because it is not too hot.
examples.tr: Sonbahar en sevdiğim mevsim, çünkü çok sıcak olmuyor.

examples.en: In autumn, the days get shorter and the nights get longer.

tr.note: Okunuşu 'otım' gibidir; sondaki 'n' okunmaz. Amerikan İngilizcesinde 'fall' da denir. Mevsim adları küçük harfle yazılır.

quiz.cloze: The leaves turn red and yellow in ______.

def.short: Saturday and Sunday, the days when many people do not work
def.long: Saturday and Sunday, when many people do not go to work or school. In some countries, the days off are different, for example Friday and Saturday.

examples.en: What are you doing this weekend?
We usually visit my grandmother at the weekend.
examples.tr: Hafta sonları genellikle büyükannemi ziyaret ederiz.

examples.en: Have a nice weekend!

tr.note: Türkçedeki 'vikend' de buradan gelir. 'At the weekend' İngiltere'de, 'on the weekend' ABD'de daha yaygındır.

mistakes.wrong: I will visit them in the weekend.
mistakes.right: I will visit them at the weekend.
mistakes.why: 'Hafta sonunda' için 'in' kullanmayın: 'at the weekend' (İngiltere) veya 'on the weekend' (ABD) denir.

quiz.cloze: I don't work on Saturday or Sunday. I rest at the ______.

def.short: later today, in the evening or at night
def.long: The evening or the night of today. People use it for plans and for things that happen later today: 'Are you free tonight?'

examples.en: Are you free tonight?
I'm tired, so I'm going to bed early tonight.
examples.tr: Yorgunum, o yüzden bu gece erken yatacağım.

examples.en: There is a football match on TV tonight.

tr.note: 'Tonight' hem 'bu akşam' hem 'bu gece' demektir. 'This night' denmez; tek kelime olan 'tonight' kullanılır.

mistakes.why: 'Bu gece / bu akşam' için tek kelime 'tonight' kullanılır; 'this night' doğal değildir.

quiz.cloze: I have a big exam tomorrow, so I will study ______.

def.short: used after a time to say how long before now something happened
def.long: Used after a length of time to say how long before now something happened. It goes after the time words and takes the past simple: two days ago.

examples.en: We moved here two years ago.
She called me ten minutes ago.
A long time ago, there was a small bakery here.
examples.tr: Uzun zaman önce burada küçük bir fırın vardı.

tr.note: Türkçede 'iki yıl önce' dersiniz. İngilizcede 'ago' sayıdan sonra gelir ve 'before' kullanılmaz: two years ago. Cümle geçmiş zamanla kurulur.

mistakes.wrong: I met her before two years.
mistakes.right: I met her two years ago.
mistakes.why: 'İki yıl önce' diye düşünüp 'before' demeyin. Geçmişte geçen süre için sayıdan sonra 'ago' gelir: two years ago.

mistakes.wrong: I have met her two years ago.
mistakes.right: I met her two years ago.
mistakes.why: 'Ago' ile bitmiş bir zaman söylendiği için 'have met' değil, geçmiş zaman (met) kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: We met in Ankara two years ______.
